# CartWise

> CartWise is a free website that helps US shoppers fight grocery inflation using only real, sourced, dated public data. It never shows sample or invented prices. If a number can't be verified, it's left out.

## Tools and data sources
- Compare stores (organic): 19 organic produce items with real prices from Trader Joe's (traderjoes.com product search, no store selected) and Whole Foods (wholefoodsmarket.com online prices, default ZIP 98101), retrieved 2026-10-12, each with a source link, next to the USDA benchmark. Sprouts, Kroger, Walmart, Aldi, Target, Costco, Safeway and Publix are shown as "not published" (they need a store selected, or showed no organic produce prices).
- Gas: a ZIP code maps to its state, which shows AAA's state average prices for regular, mid-grade, premium, and diesel, plus the state's national rank. Source: https://gasprices.aaa.com/state-gas-price-averages/
- Restaurants: Fast food and Sit-down sections. Fast food currently has no verified prices (McDonald's, Taco Bell, Wendy's, Chick-fil-A, Subway, Chipotle and Panera need a store selected), so none are shown. Sit-down estimator: party presets (couple date night, family of 4, custom) with drinks, appetizer, and dessert options, plus sales tax and tip (tip on the pre-tax subtotal). Uses median real menu prices from Denny's online menu for one listed store, labeled as an estimate. Source: https://www.dennys.com/menu
- Organic groceries (primary): enter a shopping list. Each matched item shows USDA AMS national weighted-average advertised retail prices for organic produce at major US grocery chains (weekly FVWRETAIL report, National Organic Summary), by variety and package size, with the note "Use this as a benchmark. If your store charges much more than this, look at store brands, Aldi, or Walmart." Items not in the report are left out. Source: https://www.ams.usda.gov/mnreports/fvwretail.pdf
- Tips: unit-price traps, meat and bakery markdown timing, international and bulk aisle swaps, price matching and rain checks, store-brand equivalents, shrinkflation, coupon and cash-back stacking.

## Facts
- Free, no account. Hosted as a static site.
- Each data file in /data has a "retrieved" date and a source URL.
- Not affiliated with USDA, AAA, Kroger, Walmart, or any restaurant chain.
